retrieval_note: Sources were retrieved by the agent's web search/fetch tools on 2026-10-07. READ_LEVEL says how much of each source was actually read: full_text = the page text was fetched; abstract_snippet = only search-engine abstract/snippet was seen. No content was bulk-copied into this repo.

sources.TITLE: Spot ETF Flows & Bitcoin Price Trajectory (preliminary statistical investigation)
sources.SOURCE_TYPE: buy-side research note with own statistics
sources.AUTHOR: David Lawant (FalconX Research)
sources.MARKET: US spot Bitcoin ETFs vs BTC/USD spot
sources.CLAIMED_EDGE: VAR: previous-day ETF net inflow coefficient 0.027 on today's BTC return; ETF-flow persistence 0.533; Granger causality p=0.00406 (F=8.4767); orthogonalised impulse response peaks near +1.2% around days 3-4 and is non-negative
sources.CLAIMED_RETURN: about +1.2% cumulative per positive flow shock (no cost model)
sources.DATA_SOURCE: fund issuer daily flow tables aggregated by the author
sources.DATA_AVAILABLE: YES (daily public flow tables exist from several vendors; historical reconstruction possible)
sources.RULES_COMPLETE: PARTIAL (the statistical relation is stated; no trading rule, no cost model, no entry/exit thresholds)
sources.REPRODUCIBILITY: statistical reproduction possible from public daily flows + BTC daily closes
sources.KNOWN_LIMITATIONS: author-declared: short sample, stationarity assumed, non-linearity possible; correlation only 0.30 (<10% of price variance); feedback loop from price to flows; bought-side research, not peer-reviewed

sources.RULES_COMPLETE: PARTIAL (a window around the candle turn is defined; size depends on venue microsecond timing)
sources.REPRODUCIBILITY: public data
sources.KNOWN_LIMITATIONS: gross magnitude is a fraction of the project's 23.791 bps round-trip cost floor; effect closely tied to exchange-specific candle timing

sources.DATA_SOURCE: vendor vesting/unlock database plus market prices
sources.DATA_AVAILABLE: PARTIAL (schedules are public via multiple providers; the analysed 16k-event dataset is not published)
sources.RULES_COMPLETE: PARTIAL (event categories and size bands defined; no tradable entry/exit rule, no cost model)
sources.REPRODUCIBILITY: event study reproducible on a smaller, hand-built sample; full-sample fidelity not reproducible
sources.KNOWN_LIMITATIONS: vendor research, no released sample or code; the direction of the effect is negative, so a long/cash spot runtime can only express it as avoidance
